threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the bus will get you across town quicker than the Tube. Welcome to Dalston, mate; it’s not that simple.
Last night on the 59, a lad pulled out an electric guitar and started strumming. The driver just shook his head but we all loved it.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a hipster arguing with an old man over who makes better Döner at Hermannplatz. Classic Neukölln, where stories meet at every corner.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar where they serve currywurst on tap while they blast 90s techno. It's a wild fusion of flavors and beats!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're local if they carry a reusable bag filled with takeout from La Taqueria while dodging the latest BART delays on their way home.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last week, a pigeon casually strolled onto the 31 bus, ignoring the driver’s honk. Classic Tenderloin moment, perfectly capturing our daily chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into any bar for tapas, but the best ones in Gràcia often require a reservation weeks in advance. It’s a locals' secret.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewildered faces while staring at the metro map like it’s a puzzle, especially around Passeig de Gràcia.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot the newcomers by their confusion over the 149 bus route – it goes the long way round, but they think it's a direct line.
Caught a whiff of fresh jerk chicken on the 35 last night. Turns out, the guy in the back had a whole takeaway feast. Smelled better than the bus itself.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: One morning, I saw a guy feeding pigeons while juggling. The birds didn’t care. That’s when I realized this place is wonderfully weird.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do kebab shops serve vegan versions alongside traditional meat, and nightclubs have secret rooftop gardens. It's a wild mix.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local when they don't flinch at the BART delays but still grumble about the 14 bus being late again. Only true riders know the struggle.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy on the 47 bus arguing with the driver about a late transfer. Whole bus was in on it, shouting their own grievances. Classic Muni chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into any bar and find a table. In Gràcia, you better get there early or prepare to stand, especially on a weekend.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones at the market, bewildered by the lack of plastic bags, clutching their organic avocados like treasures.
